meta.title: Office Forge
meta.description: A local Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF toolkit for reading, creating, editing, template filling, auditing, batch jobs, PDF parsing and page numbers/forms/images/OCR/encryption, legacy conversion, visual preview, formula recalculation and PDF export. It supports Word footnotes/bookmarks/cross-references/citations/bibliography/columns/watermarks/content controls/.dotx templates, Excel CSV/TSV/JSON import/array formulas/combo secondary-axis charts/native table objects and sheet protection, PowerPoint batch speaker notes/sections/38-layout library/10 deck templates/comments/audio-video/master/morph/dual engines/automatic adapter selection/aesthetic scoring/beautify/HTML decks, and per-family module switches and fine-grained feature toggles, with themes and feature catalogs loadable from resources/. When enabled, the model can call sixteen tools: officeforge_read / officeforge_create / officeforge_edit / officeforge_template / officeforge_audit / officeforge_beautify / officeforge_web / officeforge_deck / officeforge_doctor / officeforge_batch / officeforge_export / officeforge_convert / officeforge_pdf / officeforge_native / officeforge_preview / officeforge_recalculate. File operations stay inside the working directory; outputs use atomic writes with optional backups, and document logic runs in short-lived Python subprocesses. Disabling the plugin removes these tools without changing the existing Office tools or the armor-piercing plugin. Rendered-slide verification reports export JSON or HTML.
